### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `87ac96bc6050bc8c1e7389b29d0d998c386b0e9c` — the merge of head `6a4c06637b95c94871cec630475fc6c7ebaa5473` into base `2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 87ac96bc6050bc8c1e7389b29d0d998c386b0e9c && git checkout 87ac96bc6050bc8c1e7389b29d0d998c386b0e9c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9 6a4c06637b95c94871cec630475fc6c7ebaa5473 && git checkout -B drift-repro 2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9 && git merge --no-ff 6a4c06637b95c94871cec630475fc6c7ebaa5473

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 2b7c331537ae54c2060b8a64bd025f9ca6fbcdb9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6a4c06637b95c94871cec630475fc6c7ebaa5473`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts, packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts (unchanged; the severity split the door claim rests on, read at lines 1174–1175), packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.bulk-confirm-text.test.ts, packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.ledger.ts, .changeset/25205-bulk-confirm-text-refusal.md; remainder (lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, read here only as the describe's projection): content/docs/references/ui/{bulk-action,component,view}.mdx.

Inputs read at 2026-10-23T14:54Z: card #25205 (body + 3 comments: `6355077431` blocked, `6365520957` claim, `6367599529` os-dev-report), PR #25451 (body, 11-file list, `git diff origin/main...refs/review/pr-25451`), the 42 check-runs on the head, ruling `6285948976` on #24798 (2026-10-20T07:40Z), the amended 「甲」 pointer `6303865025` on #6015 (2026-10-20T23:11Z), the #25002 card and its merged changeset `.changeset/25002-page-predicate-over-budget-error.md` (landed as `31f0f279`), AGENTS.md §3 and `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (the category definitions), and the producers under `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `skills/` and HotCRM at `/home/claude/hotcrm` (`4166f21`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The parse does not move — right.** The diff on `bulk-action.zod.ts` is a comment and the `confirmText` `.describe()` string only. `BulkConfirmTextSchema` is byte-identical on the head: the `templateExpressionInput(...)` arm and the `z.string().regex(/^\s*$/)` blank arm, with the same union error. No accept-set change at `BulkActionDefSchema.parse`, no JSON Schema shape change, no export added or removed. The three `content/docs/references/ui/*.mdx` rows are the describe's regeneration and nothing else (`Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries `check:generated`, is green).
2. **The door accept set narrows, through existing door code — right.** `bulkConfirmTextIssues` now pushes `severity: 'error'` for the blank sentence, the `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` finding (unbound root, single-brace token) and every `validateExpression('template', …)` error (logic in a hole, unknown formatter). `objectstack validate` / `compile` fail on an error from `validateStackExpressions`; the publish gate's split at `runtime-gate.ts:1174–1175` (`errors = severity === 'error'`, `advisories` otherwise) turns the same finding into `422 INVALID_METADATA` on an active `view` or `object` write and on `publishMetaItem`. No door code is edited, so the "same finding at door and build" claim (test (b)) rests on one function. The module-private `BULK_CONFIRM_TEXT_WARNING_ONLY` suffix constant is removed; it was not exported, so no public surface moves.
3. **Width against ruling `6285948976` item 1 — right.** The ruling binds "an unbound root and a single-brace token are refused by name at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate through the one judge the flow text slots use" and "⛔ no CEL logic inside a hole". The PR refuses four texts, not two: the extra two are the template compile step's own errors (logic in a hole, an unknown formatter) — the one-judge mandate carries them, as the flow text slots already refuse them — and the blank sentence, which card #25205's scope line delegated to the dev ("refuse it as every template slot does, or keep it. Say which and why"). The dev said which (refuse at the doors, keep the parse arm) and why. Judged within the ruling, not beyond it.
4. **Blank `''` arm kept in the schema while the doors refuse it — right, and the #25002 shape.** The dev's reason holds in code: `loadMetaFromDb` runs `computeMetadataDiagnostics` with the parse and no authoring rule, so dropping the arm would make a stored blank row invalid on boot — a read-path narrowing the ruling does not name and #25002's "stored pages are not migrated and are not refused on read" avoids. Door test (d) pins the posture for a blank and for an unbound hole (`loaded: 1, invalid: 0`, then 422 on the next save, row untouched). The residual oddity is cosmetic: the JSON Schema still carries a `pattern: ^\s*$` arm that its own description says the doors refuse. That is the documented 18.x posture, the same as the warning-era text said in the other direction; it is not a defect.
5. **Producers — none refused.** In-repo, the only bulk defs with a `confirmText` are the 6 in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/project.view.ts`; all are holeless (no brace at all), so neither judge step fires. `examples/app-todo/src/actions/task.actions.ts:145` and the `platform-objects` `en.objects.generated.ts` rows are an action's `confirmText` (a different slot `bulkConfirmTextIssues` does not walk); `skills/` declares none. HotCRM at the local checkout `4166f21` (the PR measured `1e71d5e`; the three sentences are unchanged between them): `src/sales/views/account.view.ts` — `update_tier` binds a param named `tier` and writes `{{count}}` / `{{tier}}`; `transfer_owner` and `delete` write `{{count}}` only. All roots bound, no single brace, no logic, none blank: 0 findings. The other 9 of the card's 12 are es-ES / ja-JP / zh-CN translations in locale bundles, which this pass does not read (ruling item 3: HotCRM's 12 strings stand unchanged; the bundle gap is carried by #24814).
6. **Declaration lines — right.** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is BREAKING (AGENTS §3) and matches `feat(lint)!:`; `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` fits "a value refused or a requirement tightened" — the accepted set at the three doors tightens, and no key is added or re-meant. Both lines are line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset.
7. **Tests pin the behaviour, not the prose.** The lint suite flips four severities and inverts the "no error at all" pin into "no warning at all" with a non-empty result; the gate block now asserts `errors` with empty `advisories` on all three view shapes plus single-brace and blank per shape; the metadata-protocol block drives the real `saveMetaItem` for (a) four refusals and the draft promotion, (b) door = build on `rule`/`where`/`message`, (c) the HotCRM control saves, (d) stored blank/unbound loads then is refused on save. Read against the production diff, each assertion follows from item 2.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset `.changeset/25205-bulk-confirm-text-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor — right.** The `narrowed` kind takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves (AGENTS §3); `lint` moves in code, `spec` moves in a published describe string (the generated references and JSON Schema descriptions follow). `metadata-protocol` and `qa/dogfood` change test files only and are not bumped — right. `cli` is untouched, unlike #24798's changeset — right. A `major` is refused in this release line (`check-changeset-no-major`), so BREAKING minor is the only lawful level; `Check Changeset` on the head is `success`.
- **BREAKING under the amended 「甲」 — right.** Rule 2 of `6303865025`: a narrowing no conversion carries ships now, in 18.x, as a BREAKING minor; the warning half alone is no longer the deliverable. #24947 shipped the warning half (its changeset's "A warning, not a refusal" bullet); this is the owed refusal half, the exact #25002 pairing (#24999 warning → #25002/#25088 refusal). The changeset's "supersedes the warning-only behaviour described for the same pass earlier in this release line" sentence does the superseding work the release compiler needs.
- **ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — right.** The category is refused only when the body "carries a migration prescription", i.e. instructions for rewriting a consumer's code (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` lines 147–154, R2 self-test). This body's FROM → TO is a verdict change (warning → error, saved → 422), not a key or export mapping; the "Fix (one line)" names the author's intent-dependent rewrite of the sentence, which no ledger entry can derive. Nothing authorable is removed, renamed or re-shaped, so §3's "breaking changesets must carry their migration" clause (removal/rename of a spec key, export or config field) has nothing to carry. The alternative categories are closed on facts as the marker says: both packages publish, no ADR-0087 id exists for this verdict, and no exported symbol is named (`runtime-interface-only` / `type-surface-only` would need a `path#Symbol`). It is the #25002 marker's shape word for word, and #25002 merged with the same gate green. The gate that reads the marker (`changeset-check` → `Check Changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base MERGE_BASE`) is `success` on this head: that is the gate's verdict, and the content reading agrees with it.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on the changeset — right**, and identical to the PR body's lines; the `(narrowing: …; it ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 6303865025)` parenthesis is the #25002 spelling.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (os-dev-report `6367599529`, `deviations`), each answered:

1. *Files outside the claim's surface (authoring-rules.ts comment, runtime-gate.test.ts comment, dogfood ledger prose, three regenerated references).* Each is prose the flip made false; the references are owed by `check:generated`. Answered: in scope, correct.
2. *`bulk-action.zod.ts` edited although the blank arm is kept.* Comment and describe only, verified byte-for-byte on the schema expression. Answered.
3. *Door test placed in metadata-protocol's `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`.* The #25002 precedent's file and the only place the real `saveMetaItem` is reachable; it reads `@objectstack/lint` through its built `dist/`, so it measures only after a lint build — CI builds before `Test Core`; shards 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 of 6 are green. Answered.
4. *Full dogfood at `e644a80a`, not the head.* The head changes one string in the dogfood ledger row; `Dogfood Regression Gate` on the head itself is `success`, which supersedes the local run. Answered.
5. *Branch `claude/project-thread-gtwowq`, not `claude/issue-25205-slug`.* The claim records that branch; `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` is `success`. Answered.

`open_questions`: none declared. `out_of_scope_findings`: translated bulk `confirmText` strings in locale bundles are not judged for holes — pre-existing, carried by #24814, and ruling item 3 keeps HotCRM's strings unchanged; not this PR's debt.

Reviewer flags:

- **HotCRM measurement commit.** The PR measured HotCRM at `1e71d5e`; the local checkout read here is `4166f21`. The three bulk sentences and the `tier` param are identical at both, so the 0-findings claim stands; noted so the seat does not read the two shas as a discrepancy.
- **Check-runs at 2026-10-23T14:54Z:** 0 failed. `Test Core (3/6)` is `in_progress`; every other derived family on the head is `success`. `skipped`: `Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3)` (matrix placeholder), `Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` — all opt-in or full-battery families this diff does not trigger. The verdict below is on content and on the finished families; merge waits on `Test Core (3/6)`.
- **PR state.** #25451 is still a draft with `mergeable_state: blocked`. Marking it ready is the seat's queue step, not a review finding.
- The `.describe()` now promises a refusal of a blank sentence that the schema's own second arm accepts; a reader of the generated JSON Schema sees both. Documented posture, consistent with #25002; no action owed by this PR. If the blank arm is ever dropped, that is a parse narrowing on the read path and its own card.
